about: Movie and series servers. The 2026-10-26 measured leads first (VidZee, VidFast, VidRock, VixSrc, VidNest, VidLove), then the owner's list in the owner's order (VidLink Pro, VidSrc.to, AutoEmbed, VidSrc.su, VidSrc.sh, 2Embed, VidSrc.io, VidSrc.pm), all kept at the owner's request. In the Android app the order is by measured bitrate (cleanFirst), so VidFast leads; on the web, with Ad Shield on, servers that refuse its sandbox are left out (VidZee first) and VidNest is app only.

servers.name: VidZee · 1080p · 5.1
servers.note: Back first on 2026-10-26 (owner). The only film server measured to play inside the web Ad Shield sandbox (no pop-ups). On the Android emulators it handed its stream to Sahrae's player in 2-3 s: 1920x800 on The Dark Knight and Deadpool & Wolverine, but only 854x480 on Breaking Bad S1E1.

servers.name: VidFast · 4K
servers.note: Android emulators 2026-10-26: handed over its stream in 2-4 s; renditions 2160p at 16 Mb/s, 1080p at 6 Mb/s, 720p at 3, 480p at 1.3; played 3840x2160 on Dune: Part Two and Breaking Bad S1E1. No stream for Matlock S1E1. From a Kenyan browser it stayed on Fetching (2026-10-22 and 10-26). Refuses the web sandbox.

servers.name: VidRock · 1080p · sharpest
servers.note: Back second on 2026-10-26 (owner). On the Android emulators it handed its stream to Sahrae's player in 2-3 s and played 1920x1080 on Breaking Bad S1E1 and 1920x800 (widescreen 1080p) on Deadpool & Wolverine and The Dark Knight; the sharpest measured (1080p at 5 Mb/s). Refuses the web sandbox, so the web leaves it out while Ad Shield is on.

servers.name: VixSrc · 1080p · subtitles
servers.note: Hands over its stream in 1-2 s on every title tested; renditions 1080p at 4.5 Mb/s, 720p, 480p; in the emulator test it played 720p after a key error at 1080p. Needs referrer origin; refuses the web sandbox.

servers.name: VidNest · 1080p
servers.note: Android emulators 2026-10-26: 1920x1080 on Breaking Bad S1E1 (2.7 Mb/s) and Matlock S1E1, 1920x800 on Dune: Part Two. App only: its own web page carries adult adverts.

servers.name: VidLove · 1080p
servers.note: Where 111movies.net now forwards. From Kenya 2026-10-26: started by itself, 1920x1080 on Matlock S1E1 (about 1.1 Mb/s), but 1150x480 with a WAFIM.TV watermark on Dune: Part Two. Refuses the web sandbox.

servers.name: VidLink Pro · 1080p
servers.note: Owner's list of 2026-10-26, in the owner's order. Picture and sound not measured (the device test was stopped before it finished). Measured 2026-10-25 on Matlock: 1080p at 1.6 Mb/s, showing 720p after 40 s.
